info.title: surveyscan C15 inventory/read/capabilities API
info.description: Additive read API and authenticated signed inventory capabilities; C03/C09 unchanged. A draft codec is not an advertised runtime capability.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque keyset token bound to tenant/asset/section/projection revision; not an authorization credential.

200.description: Up to100 typed fields/2MiB JSON, each with independent evidence; items ordered by record_key then field. section_state=null and revision0 mean no1.2attempt.

400.description: Invalid/duplicate/unknown query, cursor belongs to another tenant/asset/section.

409.description: PROJECTION_CHANGED: restart without cursor to read the new section revision.

200.description: Center returns SignedInventoryCapabilities; collector returns SignedCollectorInventoryCapabilities. Maximum64KiB; no-store. Role-specific signing domains prevent substitution.

401.description: Verified client certificate required. Center also rechecks active principal against database; collector validates attested agent tenant/collector relation.

403.description: At center the active principal must be a collector.

503.description: Database or signing dependency unavailable; no private-key fallback when external signer fails.

post.description: At center: active collector mTLS, center-signed offer bound to collector generation. At managed collector: assigned agent mTLS, collector-signed offer containing unchanged center-signed frame; caller must verify both pinned keys, nonce, tenant, audiences, generations and expiry before intersecting all three offers. Local signing identity is required; default-off1.2 remains explicit. Capability proof does not authorize observations or replace central origin revocation checks.
C03/1.0 remains default. inventory12_enabled opts matching admission+registry into partial-only1.2; new senders must confirm signed capabilities first. No silent downgrade or re-sign of queued data.

202.description: HTTP acceptance alone never authorizes removal. Body is either retain/processing transport receipt or final signed center result1.0; verify original batch/digest and pinned signature before removal.

429.description: Staging quota; retain source bytes and retry.

post.description: Opt-in center+collector route for assigned agents. Fresh signed request/response use distinct inventory-profile1.2 domains. Common cadence revision and immutable baseline policy_id are separate; applied is origin-reported after durable acceptance, not remote attestation. Collector verifies and forwards unchanged frame. Windows runtime is not enabled by fetching this profile.

200.description: Signed profile1.2,64KiB bound; partial baseline12/30s worker/420s sweep, source/generation/tenant/nonce/collector bound. No heartbeat/inventory-success side effects.

403.description: Wrong agent/collector relation or origin proof

503.description: Inventory12 disabled or signing/dependency unavailable; no failed-Transit fallback

get.description: Separate profile12 application progress, scoped to current tenant/source/generation. Old C12 progress is unchanged. enabled=false preserves readable historical progress.

200.description: Effective Windows baseline and independently reported applied revision

Observation12.$comment: Draft C15.02 contract; not enabled in runtime. C03/C09 remain immutable.

MachineMTLS.description: Registered active collector certificate, generation and tenant rechecked in PostgreSQL.
